messages.text:
BL-863 — Voice-engine slice A (bridge): a durable Local/OpenAI preference resolved per turn, and an unusable engine that fails loudly instead of returning empty adapters
What it solves: BL-864 (Bubble Settings selector) depends on this slice: the phone needs a
write target and a serviceability answer before it can offer the choice.
Approval context: Sign-off is carried by the epic BL-862 (persistence shape, hot-swap, flag, Mini App deferral). Nothing extra is asked here.
One thing worth knowing before approving: making the selected engine apply without a bounce is not a free consequence of the current code. `startBridge` resolves adapters once…
BL-863 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-863" (or "reject BL-863 <reason>") to act.
